The Training/Learning Curriculum is a consolidated resource that outlines the specific learning requirements derived from the needs analysis. It includes essential information such as the business area, team, and role within that area, module/course title, total duration of the course, high-level learning objectives, course details, method of delivery, and number of users.

It provides a structured roadmap for learning and development, detailing the modules or courses that need to be undertaken by different individuals based on their roles and responsibilities. Additionally, it provides users with relevant and targeted learning opportunities to enhance their skills and performance.

The curriculum typically includes the following information:

  • Business area
  • Team/Role
  • Module/Course Title
  • Course Duration
  • High Level Learning Objectives
  • Course Details
  • Method of Delivery
  • Number of users
